# The form app and dialog covers show combo boxes at the old 150 px

## Context

#21537 (Resolves #21512) merged on 2026-11-20 at 03:39Z and removed `ComboBox`'s `width: 150` default, so an un-sized combo box now stretches with the fields beside it. Two Engine 14 covers in neomjs/pages were taken before that merge and still show the 150 px field:

- `devmode/form-app-14.jpg` (Forms & Fields' lead card): Country is 150 px wide above full-width Street, ZIP and City fields.
- `devmode/dialog-drag-drop-14.jpg` (Dialogs): Select is 150 px wide above a full-width Create Dialog 2 button.

The Engine 14 portal shows both covers from the publish on Mon 23 Nov, next to examples that render the stretched fields.

## The Problem

A cover promises what its example shows. After the publish, each of these covers shows a layout its example no longer has, and the narrow field reads as the defect #21512 fixed.

## The Architectural Reality

- `apps/portal/resources/data/example-captures.json`, recipes `form-app` (640 × 470, the Address step filled in) and `dialog-drag-drop` (Dialog 1 open). Both recipes' `after` checks still hold; the change is horizontal only.
- `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs --record <id>` renders from `dist/development/css`. A `dist` built before #21537 still draws 150 px fields, so themes are rebuilt with `-t all -e dev` first.
- No other cover or tile shows an affected field. Of #21537's published consumers, `grid-cell-editing` edits a quantity cell, `calendar` opens no event editor, and `table-filtering` keeps a pinned width; none of the 51 listed tiles is a consumer.
- Design authority: #21512 AC-1, a `ComboBox` without a width must "stretch cleanly inside `align: 'stretch'` containers".

## The Fix

Retake both covers from their unchanged recipes and replace the two files in neomjs/pages.

Measured at `dev` `32096957fc` after `node buildScripts/build/themes.mjs -f -n -e dev -t all`: three captures per recipe give the same bytes (`form-app` sha256 `f0f7f492…`, 64,249 bytes; `dialog-drag-drop` `e8ee9a29…`, 23,666 bytes). Country lines up with the fields under it; Select spans Dialog 1's body like the button under it.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] AC-1: In the new `form-app` cover, Country's left and right edges line up with Street, ZIP and City.
- [x] AC-2: In the new `dialog-drag-drop` cover, Select spans Dialog 1's body like the Create Dialog 2 button.
- [x] AC-3: Three captures per recipe give the same bytes, and neomjs/pages serves them under the existing names.
- [x] AC-4: The pages PR shows each cover before and after.

## Out of Scope

- The recipes and both examples.
- The Dialogs group's renewal under #21367; a renewed dialog example brings its own cover.
